notes.text: Sections were omitted in the general amendment of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965, Pub. L. 89–10, by Pub. L. 103–382, title I, § 101, Oct. 20, 1994, 108 Stat. 3519. Section 2961, Pub. L. 89–10, title I, § 1561, as added Pub. L. 100–297, title I, § 1001, Apr. 28, 1988, 102 Stat. 210, provided general authority for national programs and activities.
